snippet.title: Super Agent - Reveal Trailer (Playdate)
snippet.description:
Super Agent is a 3D platformer game featuring special levels, such as piloting a helicopter or snowboarding. It will include 18 levels across three worlds: Forest, Antarctic and Ancient Egypt.

Developed by Risolvi Productions.
Soundtrack by Rupert Cole.

Coming in 2025.
